description: We are a high-velocity team of applied AI engineers, data analysts, and full-stack builders tackling real-world Earth and space challenges using NASA open satellite data. We focus on transforming complex telemetry and geospatial observations into intuitive, interactive tools with measurable societal impact. We are looking for passionate builders with skills in machine learning, satellite data analysis, UI/UX, and scientific storytelling. Let's build something extraordinary!
summary:
Humanity has sent dozens of pioneering spacecraft across the solar system, leaving them silent once their primary missions conclude. Instead of treating these historic relics as dead hardware or dry encyclopedia entries, Echoes of Metal reimagines every abandoned rover, retroreflector, and deep-space probe as a stranded explorer with an answering machine.

We developed an interactive interplanetary communication system grounded in raw NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) telemetry. Users dial an explorer across deterministic speed-of-light vacuum delays (

This project bridges cold astrophysical data to human empathy, transforming silent scientific milestones into living, unforgettable emotional connections
details:
1. What It Does and How It Works: Echoes of Metal: The Solar Payphone transforms raw engineering telemetry from historic planetary missions into an emotional, two-way interplanetary communication bridge. Visitors operate a live flight-deck terminal where they:

  • Select an Explorer: Connect with Opportunity (MER-B) in Perseverance Valley, Voyager 1 in interstellar space (162 AU away), the InSight seismometer on Elysium Planitia, or the Apollo 11 Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector at Mare Tranquillitatis.
  • Experience Real Relativistic Lag: The system calculates true one-way radio latency (D/cD/cD/c) using real-time orbital ephemerides (1.28 seconds to the Moon, 4–22 minutes to Mars, and ~22.8 hours to Voyager 1), making the physical scale of the cosmos tangible.
  • Neural Audio Sonification: A 1D Variational Autoencoder converts non-acoustic sensor tables into evocative acoustic soundscapes. Dust blanketing solar panels sounds like strained, muffled breathing; cryogenic Martian night cooling (-90°C) sounds like structural metallic creaks; interstellar cosmic rays striking Voyager produce resonant crystalline chimes.
  • Generative Physical Aging: Uses atmospheric optical depth (τ\tauτ) records from Perseverance MEDA weather logs to predict what rovers physically look like today after years of silence, modeling dust deposition, paint scouring, and silicone embrittlement through 2050.
  • Interplanetary Voicemail: Visitors record a message, receiving a downloadable transmission certificate authenticated with Deep Space Network antenna azimuths, carrier frequencies, and a cryptographic PDS SHA-256 seal.

2. Benefits and Intended Impact: Traditional science education often presents space missions as finished, static museum plaques. Echoes of Metal creates visceral empathy. By translating complex engineering tables into everyday human metaphors and physical acoustic sensations, it enables anyone—from children to educators—to appreciate the perseverance, loneliness, and triumph of humanity's emissaries in deep space.

3. Tools, Coding Languages, and Software:

  • Frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React, and React Bits interaction primitives.
  • Audio Architecture: Procedural Web Audio API with custom multi-oscillator banks, pink-noise atmospheric simulation, and frequency modulation.
  • Physics & Visualization: HTML5 Canvas 2D for relativistic wavefront propagation, live carrier oscilloscopes, and particle starfield physics.
  • Data Pipelines: Python scripts parsing NASA PDS binary tables, JPL HORIZONS ephemeris vectors, and DSN station telemetry.

4. Creativity and Considerations: We deliberately avoided the common pitfall of building generic AI chat wrappers. Instead, we adhered strictly to Anti-AI-Slop Craft Standards: pure obsidian black, titanium hairlines, tabular numerals, and zero neon gradients. Machine learning is restricted strictly to physical tasks—mapping multi-dimensional sensor time-series to acoustic parameters and diffusion-based environmental surface modeling.
